headline: Sensex falls 200 points at pre-open; Zydus Life dips 3% while Mahanadi Coalfields prepares for debut

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex dropped 200 points at pre-open, with Nifty 50 falling below the 25,900 level
IT stocks led early losses in the opening bell session on November 27
Zydus Life shares declined 3% after receiving a Complete Response Letter from the USFDA
Mahanadi Coalfields is debuting on the stock market following a $969 million IPO
whatHappening: Asian markets showed gains even as the Indian market opened in the red
Bharat Coking Coal is identified as one of the stocks showing a trending up RSI
Business Standard highlighted Urban Company and Leela Palaces as stocks to watch for the day
Recent sessions saw significant gains driven by foreign institutional investor buying and fund inflows
summary: The Indian stock market opened lower on November 27, with the Sensex dropping 200 points and Nifty slipping below 25,900. IT stocks faced selling pressure, while Zydus Life shares fell 3% due to regulatory hurdles from the USFDA. Meanwhile, Mahanadi Coalfields prepared for its market debut following a successful $969 million IPO.
